text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Signs and symptoms of overdose with OSMITROL include renal failure and AKI, hypo/hypervolemia, hyperosmolarity and electrolyte imbalances, CNS toxicity (e.g., coma, seizures), some of which can be fatal [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2 , 5.3 , 5.4 )]. Management of overdosage with OSMITROL is symptomatic and supportive. Discontinue the infusion and institute appropriate corrective measures with particular attention to renal, cardiac and pulmonary systems . Correct fluid and electrolyte imbalances. OSMITROL is dialyzable (hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis), hemodialysis may increase OSMITROL elimination.
